copy.tagline: 按红绿重构循环编写测试驱动代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果坚持测试驱动开发，需要规范红绿重构流程
copy.tagline_en: Write test-driven code with red-green-refactor cycle
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you practice TDD and need a structured red-green-refactor workflow

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照“先写测试、再写代码、最后优化”的流程工作，每次只做让测试通过的最小改动，并持续改进代码质量。
howto.when: 当你要求实现新功能、修复 bug 或处理复杂逻辑时，Claude 会先让你描述预期行为，然后自动进入红-绿-重构循环。

say.text: 帮我用 TDD 方式写一个加法函数。
修复这个 bug，先写测试再改代码。
say.note: Claude 会先写一个暴露 bug 的测试，然后修复代码。

say.text: 重构这段代码，保持所有测试通过。
say.note: Claude 会在不破坏现有测试的前提下优化代码结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow a 'test-first, code-second, refactor-last' workflow, writing minimal code to pass tests and continuously improving code quality.
howto.when_en: When you ask to implement a new feature, fix a bug, or handle complex logic, Claude will first ask for expected behavior, then enter the RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle.

say_en.text: Help me write an add function using TDD.
say_en.note: Claude will write a failing test, then minimal code to pass, then refactor.

say_en.text: Fix this bug, write a test first then change code.
say_en.note: Claude will write a test that exposes the bug, then fix the code.

say_en.text: Refactor this code while keeping all tests passing.
say_en.note: Claude will optimize code structure without breaking existing tests.
